name: Pronunciation registry and governance
source_attribution: MKOS Pronunciation, Audio, and TTS Standardization Framework
Pronunciation Feedback and Admin Override System

change_log.summary: Initial pronunciation framework from the three pronunciation specifications.

thresholds.action: do not use as preferred pronunciation; require validation

owner_list.note: the owner's central pronunciation list (med/says): authoritative, inherited by every account

owner_asis.note: confirmed to sound right as written (med/saylog asis)

owner_unconfirmed.note: an AI suggestion in the owner's list not yet confirmed (switched off)

ai_generated.note: candidate from a free AI service, calibrated by the owner's historical acceptance rate

admin_custom.note: written or approved by the owner in MKOS

tts_use.note: Only records at or above this confidence (admin-approved and locked records always are) are spoken. Medium-band records are kept for monitoring and review but not spoken, preserving the owner's rule that an unheard AI guess is never used in a lesson. Set pronunciation.tts_use.min_overall_confidence to 80 to speak the 'approved with monitoring' band too.

precedence: an account's own list (that account only)

generation.who: concepts whose names are likely misread (medications, eponyms, long or Latin/Greek terms) and terms flagged by the owner
generation.never_overwrite: admin_locked records; candidates are attached as suggestions instead

propagation_mechanism: Every voice path on the server (Google Cloud TTS, Cloudflare voice, card and question audio, tutor speech) resolves text through one respelling step (respell in src/worker.js) whose list is: the account's own list, then the owner's central list, then the MKOS records cleared for speech. A correction made once is heard everywhere on the next request; nothing is copied into lessons or cards.
learning: Shared linguistic structure (beginnings and endings of corrected terms)
